title: Methane meets oxygen
context: Complete combustion of methane produces carbon dioxide and water.

title: Peroxide breaks apart
context: Hydrogen peroxide can decompose into water and oxygen.

title: Carbon monoxide meets oxygen
context: Carbon monoxide can react with oxygen to form carbon dioxide.

title: A nitrogen oxide changes
context: Nitric oxide can combine with oxygen to form nitrogen dioxide.

title: A sulfur oxide changes
context: Sulfur dioxide can be oxidised to sulfur trioxide.

title: Ozone rearranges
context: Ozone can decompose to molecular oxygen.

title: Water breaks apart
context: Electrolysis can split water into hydrogen and oxygen.

title: Ethylene meets oxygen
context: Complete combustion of ethylene produces carbon dioxide and water.

title: Hydrogen meets chlorine
context: Hydrogen and chlorine can combine to form hydrogen chloride.

title: Methanol meets oxygen
context: Complete combustion of methanol produces carbon dioxide and water.
